core_semantic_validation.inference: claim-specific transformation quality for the original core normalized activity universe

core_reviewer_reliability.design: deterministic stratified subset of the 50 frozen second-review candidates

targeted_accela_audit.inference: failure-mode evidence by component; no population-wide Accela accuracy estimate

initial_longitudinal_audit.design: 20 high-impact or flagged changes plus 10 deterministic controls
initial_longitudinal_audit.inference: interpretation of the initial source-publication comparison only

future_longitudinal_cycles.selection: all critical or substantively important flags up to the cap, plus deterministic random controls
future_longitudinal_cycles.trigger: each release cycle with a new canonical comparison

claim_boundaries.source_fidelity: automated reconciliation plus selected manual spot checks
claim_boundaries.normalization_semantics: core probability sample and targeted Accela audit
claim_boundaries.gis_accela_linkage: targeted risk-based cases reported by decision type
claim_boundaries.longitudinal_changes: changes in source publication; not proof of physical-world change

legacy_assignment_policy: Original frozen assignment files remain unchanged for provenance. Only IDs listed by the v2 active-subset files are required under this plan.
